summary: Six fsync-bound fractal tests that check what their stores hold, not what reaches a disk, keep their stores on /dev/shm where it exists (new test-support helper memory_tempdir): reconcile_pass_perf 35.7 -> 3.1 s, backup 25.8 -> 5.4 s, the 29 setup tests 69.3 -> 16.5 s, operation_audit's mutation helper (projection_drift 47.3 -> 27.2 s), and the delivery probe's fake-API cases 11.5 -> 2.1 s. operation_audit_perf and checkpoint_memory stay on disk.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to put these tests' stores back on the temporary directory's disk.
